basics.name: Thomas De Min
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Information Engineering and Computer Science
basics.summary: I am a Ph.D. student at the University of Trento, supervised by Prof. Elisa Ricci and Dr. Massimiliano Mancini. My research focuses on multimodal large language models, proactiveness, and how post-training shapes factual knowledge, building on earlier work in continual learning and machine unlearning.

work.name: FunAI Lab - Prof. Yuki Asano
work.summary: Investigated factual knowledge acquisition, loss, and reappearance during LLM post-training.

work.name: University of Trento
highlights: Delivered PyTorch labs covering MLP, LeNet, and CLIP using Google Colab and AWS.
Designed a few-shot CLIP adaptation project on the Oxford Flowers dataset.
Graded projects contributing one third of the final course grade.

work.name: Inria - Thoth
highlights: Developed a state-of-the-art class-incremental learning method using parameter-efficient fine-tuning and vision transformers.
Reduced computational overhead compared to previous methods.
Work awarded an oral presentation at the ICCV 2023 VCL Workshop.

work.name: University of Trento
work.position: Course Tutor for Programming and Deep Learning
highlights: Designed and evaluated C/C++ programming exercises.
Assessed student projects and led oral evaluations in deep learning.

work.name: BlueTensor
highlights: Delivered computer vision pipelines for panoptic segmentation, object recognition, and face re-identification.
Engineered behavior clustering using BERT and k-means.
Designed multi-camera tracking infrastructure.

courses: Supervised by Prof. Elisa Ricci and Dr. Massimiliano Mancini.
